Be part of our team!

 

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful Quality Engineering Team at our plant in Leoben, we are looking for passionate 2 Junior Customer Quality Engineer (f/m/d) Our Quality Engineering teams are at the core of ensuring product excellence and customer satisfaction, working in focus areas:

Customer-Focused Quality Assurance - acting as the primary liaison for customer requirements, documentation, audits, and issue resolution.

Production Quality Assurance - monitoring and improving internal processes, ensuring compliance, and driving continuous improvement.

Depending on your strengths, your role may emphasize direct customer interaction or internal quality assurance activities.

 

Your Responsibilities

 

Customer-Focused Tasks

 * Implement and monitor customer-defined quality requirements in production

 * Prepare and maintain quality documentation (Certificates of Conformance, inspection and reliability specifications) and coordinate customer approvals

 * Organize and support customer audits and visits; ensure smooth communication and execution

 * Review and align internal processes with customer specifications; manage claims and 8D processes

 

Production-Focused Tasks

 * Monitor compliance with internal quality standards and initiate corrective actions to prevent nonconformities

 * Support qualification of new materials, equipment, and processes; promote continuous improvement and advanced problem-solving methods

 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, NPI, QE, Laboratory) to standardize quality requirements across all product life stages

 

 

Your Profile

 

 * HTL graduate, University degree in e.g. Engineering or equivalent proven experience

 * Strong communication skills in English for the Customer focused role and German language skills for the Production focused role

 * Proficient in Microsoft Office; organized and eager to learn

 * Experience in customer or supplier communication and substrate industry is an advantage

 

Our Offer

 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and available e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits

The role supports the identification, establishment, and maintenance of strategic collaborations and contributes to the preparation and execution of (funded) R&D activities. In addition, the position maintains partner-related information, supports consortium building, and helps increase the visibility and effectiveness of AT&S's external innovation ecosystem. Through close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, the role contributes to the successful execution of AT&S's research and innovation strategy. 

Your Responsibilities 
 * Develop and maintain strategic relationships with universities, research institutes, industrial partners, clusters, and funding-related stakeholders to strengthen AT&S's innovation ecosystem and collaboration opportunities

 * Maintain and further develop partner relationship management tools, databases, and processes to ensure transparency, accessibility, and quality of partner-related information
 * Prepare analyses, reports, and management summaries on partner activities, collaboration opportunities, and innovation ecosystem developments
 * Support the preparation of national and international funding proposals to increase public funding opportunities
 * Facilitate consortium building and stakeholder coordination for collaborative R&D projects to ensure effective project initiation and execution
 * Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration across AT&S and external organizations through networking activities, workshops, and best-practice exchange
 * Support the organization, coordination, and execution of partner events, workshops, innovation forums, and networking activities 

Your Profile 
 * University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Engineering, Natural Sciences, Innovation Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
 * Several years of professional experience in R&D, innovation management, public funding, collaboration management, project management, or a related area
 * (Strong) technical understanding of semiconductor packaging, IC substrate technologies, PCB technologies, advanced manufacturing technologies, or related fields
 * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with CRM, database, or collaboration management tools is beneficial
 * Experience in collaborating with external partners in industrial or research environments
 * Good understanding of public funding programs, collaborative R&D projects, universities, research organizations, or familiarity with national and/or European funding programs is an advantage
 * Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders
 * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously
 * Analytical mindset with the ability to prepare reports, presentations, and management summaries
 * Fluent English and German language skills

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.

What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Senior Engineer Mixed Signal Layout in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life.

Are you in?

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Full Custom Layout: Execute full-custom IC and block-level layout from schematic to tape-out for ADC mixed-signal components

 * Layout Optimization: Implement precise matching techniques and isolation strategies to prevent noise coupling in sensitive analog front-ends 

 * Physical Verification: Run and debug full-chip physical verifications, including DRC, LVS, ERC, and antenna rule checks 

 * Parasitic Management: Analyze and minimize parasitic resistance, capacitance, and inductance to ensure signal and power integrity

 * Top-Level Integration: Perform floor planning, pad-ring assembly, and final chip integration, considering ESD, latch-up, and electromigration (EM) guidelines

 * Leadership & Mentorship: Provide technical leadership during project execution and mentor junior layout engineers within the team

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or a comparable field

 * Ideally 5+ years of hands-on experience in CMOS and FinFET semiconductor technologies 

 * High proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre, etc.)

 * Excellent analytical skills to independently debug complex layout and physical verification issues

 * Excellent communication skills to bridge technical gaps across global, multidisciplinary engineering teams

 * The ability to guide, motivate, and coordinate small layout teams during project execution, and to collaborate closely with ADC Design Engineers

 * Fluent in English

This position is initially limited to a period of 2 years. We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualifications. At PALFINGER, we have been lifting goods to a new level for over 90 years - with a pioneering and passionate spirit. Our success is based on the tireless efforts of our approximately 12,350 employees, who contribute their ideas and energy to our vision. With us, you can expect a dynamic working environment full of opportunities for personal and professional development. Become part of our team and start your career at PALFINGER.

 

We are looking for a flexible, assertive, and communicative personality for active collaboration with our regional and local process experts in the international PALFINGER sales units.  * Define system-related process requirements for O2C processes (SAP SD) validate changes (incl. testing coordination) and conduct rollout changes within the global change-control framework (RFC process)

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

 * Strong background in global process or data management or BPM Roles (ideally in Sales environment and SAP SD touchpoints), with at least 3-4 years of related experience

 * Ability to define and track KPIs to monitor and improve data and process quality

 * Strong capability to model and maintain end-to-end processes and documentation using BPMN 2.0 within a scalable global template approach

 * Proven track record in leading international data and process optimization projects, rollout implementation, and a solid understanding of ERP/system customization, including requirements validation

 * Excellent training and collaboration skills; fluent English and willingness to travel internationally

WE OFFER

 * Flexible working hours with no core time and possibility to work from home
